slots.jd.cloud-software.about:
About the role
We're Nimbus Cloud Software, and we're growing fast. We need an HR Manager who can keep our people practices simple, fair and compliant while we scale. You'll work remotely across the US, be the go-to person for managers and employees, and build the processes we don't have yet. If you like rolling up your sleeves and getting things done, you'll fit right in.
slots.jd.cloud-software.duties:
What you'll do
- Advise managers on employee relations, from tricky conversations to formal investigations
- Be the first stop for employee concerns and see each one through to resolution
- Write and roll out policy updates as we grow, and explain them in plain language
- Coach managers on documentation and consistent decisions
- Spot patterns in employee concerns and suggest fixes before they become bigger problems
slots.jd.cloud-software.needs:
What we're looking for
- 13 or more years of HR experience
- Senior HR Practitioner Certificate (required)
- Solid compliance reporting and policy writing skills
- Hands-on experience with job postings, interview scheduling and new hire onboarding
- Day-to-day experience with ADP Workforce Now

slots.r1.b4: Schedules interviews across hiring teams and runs exit interviews, feeding departure themes back into interview questions.
slots.r1.b5: Updates HR policies and aligns job postings with each change, reducing candidate questions about role terms by 45 percent.

slots.r1.i2: Oversees new hire paperwork at Oakmont Systems so every hire starts with complete, accurate records.

slots.r2.b2: Answered employee benefits questions and drafted offer letters that set out benefits terms clearly for new hires.
slots.r2.b3: Handled employee concerns and used policy writing to clarify grievance steps, lowering repeat complaints by 15 percent.

slots.r2.b5: Advised managers on employee relations and used payroll coordination to resolve pay disputes, reducing payroll escalations by 10 percent.

slots.r3.b1: Maintained HR records for new hire onboarding and cut incomplete employee files by 55 percent.

slots.summary.1: HR manager with 13 years of experience leading a team and answering for the results of the human resources function. Runs performance review cycles, compliance reporting and job postings, and holds the Senior HR Practitioner Certificate.
